chose: Home finds the issue a take became by two unauthenticated GitHub searches every 15 minutes, `user:paulgsc author:paulgsc "From take" in:body` with `is:issue` and with `is:pull-request`, sorted by update, reading back to an hour before the last pass and each body for `From take tk…`; only an issue moves a take to Became, and a pull request adds a link. The same queries keep found items' state current.
options: two searches of the owner's own items across their public repositories every 15 minutes
gray: The owner named public search with no key but no freshness or scope; these set how soon "Became #n" appears and which repositories count.
undo: Change the query or the interval in home's search pass; the link and seen rows don't depend on how they were read.
